name: Change in the poverty rate, 2015-2019 to 2020-2024

metadata.description: Percentage-point change in the share of people below the poverty line, 2015-2019 to 2020-2024, diverging blue (rate fell) to red (rate rose), white at zero. Measured over 81,410 tracts with a legitimate chg_pct_below_poverty value (geo_change identical, absorbed or subdivided; mixed/no_acs_data tracts carry NULL and draw gray): 8 classes with breaks at -15/-8/-3/0/3/8/15 points, which fall at the 4th/14th/34th/55th/74th/91st/98th percentile of the national distribution and none empty (3,200/8,151/15,989/17,182/16,055/13,223/5,677/1,933 tracts). 54.7% of tracts improved (chg below 0).
